title: VMC Motion CDZ200L
author: VMC Motion Technologies Co., Ltd.
adaptation: Original CAD geometry is retained. Display materials are recolored; visible meshes are batched by assembly and material. Hidden_Colliders proxies are excluded, original CrawlerBelt meshes retained. Blade lift uses original CFrame axle and lift cylinder pin centres; angle and tilt assemblies retain their authored pose. This is a fictional machine and a kinematic classroom demonstration, not AGX simulation or verified real-world performance.
